---
name: Architecture task
about: Capture structural work such as new data layers, state sync, or backend integrations.
title: "[architecture] "
labels: type:architecture
assignees: []
---

## Context
Summarize why this architectural change is needed and what portion of StageHand it affects (state store, sync layer, backend, etc.).

## Proposed approach
- Outline the modules, APIs, and data boundaries involved.
- Call out any third-party services (e.g., real-time sync, payment processors).

## Success criteria
- List the deliverables (updated docs, new state hook, GraphQL schema, etc.).
- Include rollout/verification plans (migrations, tests, canary).

## Risks & mitigation
- Flag backwards-incompatible changes or areas that require coordination with other teams.
